newsitem.title: USA: Intel stock up amid strong tech outlooks.
newsitem.headline: Intel stock up amid strong tech outlooks.

text.p: The stock of semiconductor maker Intel Corp. rose sharply Wednesday on strong outlooks provided by key personal computer and networking companies, analysts said.
The stock of Santa Clara, Calif.-based Intel was up $2.75 at $98.50 in late trading on Nasdaq where it was one of the most active issues.

Tuesday, Dell Computer Corp. said it saw surging demand from owners of older personal computer upgrading their systems as helping boost growth. Specifically, Dell cited the move toward fast Pentium chips made by Intel.

On Wednesday, network equipment maker Cisco Systems Inc. provided bullish acquisition-related comments at a Montgomery Securities investment conference in San Fransciso. Cisco said it expected to acquire six to 10 new companies in the next 12 months.

"People have just looked (at this late news) as a pat on the back and have gone back to buying again," said Dan Niles, analyst at Robertson Stephens and Co. "We're getting more information that this is not a fake rally."
Along with Intel, Cisco rose $1.875 to $64, Dell jumped $4.375 to $81.25 on Nasdaq. Compaq Computer Corp. gained $1.25 to $65.625 on the New York Stock Exchange.
